verses.text: A psalm by David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah. God, you are my God. I seek you with all my heart. My soul thirsts for you, and my body longs for you in a dry, weary land where there’s no water.
I’ve seen you in the sanctuary and looked on your power and glory.
Your faithful love is better than life, so my lips will praise you.
I’ll bless you as long as I live. I’ll lift my hands in your name.
My soul will be satisfied as if I’d eaten the richest food. I’ll praise you with joyful lips
when I remember you on my bed and think about you through the watches of the night.
You’ve been my help, so I’ll sing for joy in the shadow of your wings.
My soul clings to you, and your right hand holds me up.
Those who want to destroy me will go down into the depths of the earth.
They’ll be handed over to the sword and become food for jackals.
But the king will rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, because the mouths of liars will be shut.
